title: fix(objectql): the object fold names a field two extensions declare, and which definition it serves
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4oSWnFYFtpNR7L96S4qiN1)_

Fixes #28835

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象合并时，两个扩展在 `fields` 里声明了同名字段，或某个扩展在 `fields` 里重新声明了所有者自己的字段，注册表现在会在日志里记一行：对象、字段、按合并顺序列出的所有声明包，以及最终生效的是哪个包的定义。同一注册表只记一次。
- **为什么改**：合并按 `priority` 升序、同优先级按注册先后，后者直接覆盖前者，之前没有任何提示。#28811 开放 `object_extension` 条目后，Studio 也能走到这条路径。
- **风险与回滚**：只加一行 `warn`，生效的定义一个字节不变，不拒绝任何东西，保存、发布、`os validate` 都没动。仓库里出货的包和示例没有一处这样冲突。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `reportRedeclaredFields`，以及 `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` 循环里新增的 `folded.push` 一行。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-extension-redeclared-field.test.ts`，预期 10/10。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One warning at the fold.** `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` records each extension's `fields` as the merge took them (after the audit and `queue` governance), in fold order. After the loop, `reportRedeclaredFields` finds every field name declared by more than one contributor: two extensions, or an extension and the owner (a name in `ownFieldNamesOf(owner)`, the set the field-patch judge already uses). For each, it writes one `console.warn` naming the object, the field, every declaring package in fold order (the owner first when it declares the field), and the package whose definition is served, which is the last one the fold applies.
- **Once per registry.** Keyed `object|field|packages` in a per-registry set, beside `fieldPatchMissesWarned`. Repeated reads (`getObject`, `foldObjectExtendersOnto`, the code layer) do not repeat it; a second registry says it again.
- **Judged from the contributors, not the running body.** A base that already carries the extensions' fields (a folded body handed back to `foldObjectExtendersOnto`, a stored overlay row) is not read as a redeclaration.
- **Not counted.** `fieldPatches` (not a declaration; a patch that misses is already named). A `.custom` pair's `__c` field and a dependent's plain field never share a name, so they never meet here; the `__c` judge is untouched.
- **Unchanged.** The merged definition, byte for byte, and every door: no change to save, publish, restore, `os validate` or the install door.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` said "nothing warns when they do"; it now says what the log names, and that the one registered last wins at equal priority.

## Why

The PR #28811 contract review (record `6565271420`, should-fix 2) found that two extenders of one object declaring the same field name resolve last-writer-wins with no refusal and no report. The seat's route: report at the fold, keep today's winner, refuse nothing.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/registry-extension-redeclared-field.test.ts`, 10 cases.

Warning cases (each asserts the served definition first, then the line):
- two dependents both add `region` at priority 200: the one registered last is served, one line names both and the served one;
- the same by priority: the 300 registered first is served and named;
- an extension redeclaring the owner's `industry`: one line names the owner, the extension and the served one;
- the owner and two extensions on one field: one line naming all three in fold order;
- two `.custom` pairs both adding `region__c`;
- a second registry names it again.

Controls (nothing named): one extension adding its own field; a pair's `region__c` beside a dependent's `region`; `fieldPatches` beside an added field; a folded body handed back to the fold. Every case reads `getObject`, `foldObjectExtendersOnto` and `getArtifactItem` three times with the cache dropped between.

<details><summary>Red first and ablation (head ce7c7fa3)</summary>

- **Red first.** `registry.ts` checked out from main `7e60dc23`: `Tests 6 failed | 4 passed (10)`. All six fail on the line count (`expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`); the served-definition assertions before them pass, so the winner is the same on main. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `git diff HEAD` empty, porcelain empty.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the `this.reportRedeclaredFields(...)` call replaced by `void 0`), run over this file and `registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts`: `Tests 6 failed | 21 passed (27)`, the same six warning cases; the four controls and #28809's 17 stay green. `ok restored: blob == HEAD (c47d8f140f3c) and git diff HEAD is empty`, marker count 0.
- The test imports `./registry.js` from `src/`, so no `dist/` leg is involved.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites, typecheck, lint, gates (head ce7c7fa3)</summary>

After merging main (with #28836) and a whole-repo `pnpm build` (VERDICT command-exit 0):
- objectql full suite: `Test Files 524 passed (524)`, `Tests 10036 passed (10036)`.
- objectql `pnpm typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK` (39 files / 233 errors / 64 signatures held, unchanged).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched source files: exit 0.
- Tests that spy on `console.warn` beside an `extend` registration in other packages: rest `rest-exposure-gate-one-object-read` 37/37, runtime `package-uninstall-store-refusal.integration` 5/5, cloud-connection `marketplace-install-local-field-patch-targets` 8/8.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 92 derived, 92 run, all exit 0. `--ran`: 92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured: no shipped collision.** `packages/**`, `examples/**` and HotCRM hold two `objectExtensions` entries: `examples/app-showcase` extends its own `showcase_account` (priority 210, `loyalty_tier`, `linkedin_url`, `csat_score`, none declared by the owner), and `plugin-auth` extends `sys_sso_provider` (`oidc_client_secret`, not declared in `platform-objects`). Different objects, so no fold sees two declarers. HotCRM declares none. `packages/qa/downstream-contract` (private) has one fixture extension of `dc_account`, alone.
- **Boot probe.** Showcase and plugin-auth registered into one ObjectQL from `dist/`, every one of 54 objects read through `getObject` and `foldObjectExtendersOnto`: 0 lines. Positive control (a third extension redeclaring `showcase_account.name` and `linkedin_url`): 2 lines, each naming the served package. Script: project files `pm-orders/server/evidence/28835/boot-probe.mts`.
- **Existing tests now print the line twice, both true redeclarations:** `registry-object-overlay-layer.test.ts` (a package extending its own object with `name`, the overlay counter-factual) and an audit-governance test (an extender declaring `created_at`, served with the platform's `readonly`). Neither asserts on warnings.
- **Merging #28836.** After main took #28836, its option-patch tests filter warnings on the substring `fieldPatches`, and their takeover cases redeclare `industry`, so my line's first wording ("through `fieldPatches`") matched their filter and failed 2 of their cases. The line now says "patch an owner field's display properties instead of redeclaring it", and both files pass 27/27.
- **Overlap.** Open PRs re-read before opening: none of #28850, #28860, #28862, #28873, #28875 touches `objectql/src/registry.ts` or the docs page. Main is 4 commits ahead (#28853, #28857 and two others); `git merge-tree` is clean and none touches these files.
- **Changeset.** `patch` for `@objectstack/objectql`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` at line start: one log line, no accept set or served shape moves.

## Verification

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-extension-redeclared-field.test.ts
```

Expect `Tests 10 passed (10)`.
